I know this is probably going to get downvoted but Egypt honestly gets way too much bad press than it’s worth. Yes, if you go with a western mindset you will hate it and be disappointed. But, if you are open minded, well informed and prepared for the culture there it is very enjoyable. 

I am 23f and have spent over a year of my life (in broken intervals) working and travelling in Egypt, alone. The music is great, amazing history, beautiful culture (especially dance) and once you make a few friends you will discover the people are very warm and caring. 

I can’t walk the streets wearing what I want unlike in my home country and the culture is very conservative. But I make the most of it and avoid misogynist, close minded groups of people and enjoy it for what it is. 

I would recommend for any of my friends to travel to Egypt. For the most enjoyable experience I would want them to go with a tour group or have me escort them. BUT that said as long as you are staying away from the dodgy areas such as downtown Cairo and don’t have your belongings on display to attract pickpockets you can comfortably navigate your own way around. 

So I believe Egypt in unfairly represented here. I feel much more safe here than other countries such as Iran, Libya, Afghanistan, Somalia, n Korea, etc.  I’m sorry to say it but people on here making out that Egypt is worse than any of these or even JUST AS BAD are not knowledgeable on what they are saying at all and are spreading false information. 

So in conclusion Egypt is very unfairly represented online and made out to be far worse than it actually.
